blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, Negros Occidental — The Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Board (RTWPB) in Western Visayas has approved a daily minimum wage increase of P40 to P45 for private-sector workers, pending the approval of the labor secretary. RTWPB-6 chair Sixto Rodriguez Jr. announced on Saturday that the increase would cover workers in Western Visayas, including […]...
